question: Compare monthly completed revenue by product and create a report
sql: SELECT product_id, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', event_date) AS month, SUM(IF(status='Complete', sale_price, 0)) AS revenue FROM scoped_sales GROUP BY 1,2
analyst_report: Compare complete months with the same scope. Separate units from price and product mix. Partial months are not comparable to full months. Treat explanations as hypotheses pending evidence.
metric_definition: Revenue is completed item sale_price; date is UTC item creation. Returned/cancelled items excluded. This is not GAAP revenue.

question: Why are customers in one state underspending compared to another state? Compare customer behavior
sql: SELECT state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customers, SUM(IF(status='Complete',sale_price,0)) AS revenue FROM scoped_sales GROUP BY state
analyst_report: Check spend per purchasing customer, completed order value and units. Different customer bases and product mixes can explain totals. Observational differences are not proof of causation. No order in scope is not proof of churn.
metric_definition: Customer means a distinct pseudonymous purchaser of an authorized product during the requested period.
